categories.main_business_segments: Nutanix operates as a single operating and reportable segment focused on providing cloud software solutions. The company offers the Nutanix Cloud Platform, which enables organizations to build and manage hybrid multicloud infrastructures for running applications and managing data across data centers, edge locations, and public clouds.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Nutanix pioneered hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI), merging compute, storage, and networking into a software-defined platform. Its core technologies include Nutanix AOS (scale-out storage), Nutanix AHV (native hypervisor), Kubernetes management, unified storage, database-as-a-service, and AI solutions like GPT-in-a-Box. The company develops its software to run on a variety of hardware platforms and public clouds, with a strong emphasis on software innovation, security, and integration with ecosystem partners.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nutanix serves a broad and diverse customer base across industries such as automotive, consumer goods, education, energy, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, public sector, retail, technology, and telecommunications. Its customers include over 26,000 end customers as of July 31, 2024, including approximately 1,060 Global 2000 enterprises, as well as service providers who use Nutanix to deliver cloud-based services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Nutanix operates globally with offices and customers in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Latin America, and Africa. In fiscal 2024, approximately 45% of total revenue was derived from international customers, and the company maintains a significant international workforce and R&D presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nutanix is positioned as a software provider in the IT infrastructure supply chain, operating downstream by delivering software solutions that run on third-party or OEM hardware. The company does not manufacture hardware itself; instead, it relies on partners like Supermicro and OEMs for hardware production, while focusing on software development, integration, and support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Nutanix's strategic priorities include expanding its hybrid multicloud platform, deepening partnerships with channel, OEM, cloud, and ecosystem partners, and driving profitable growth. R&D efforts focus on enhancing core offerings, integrating with ecosystem partners, supporting modern applications and AI workloads, and developing new features such as Project Beacon for Kubernetes and data-centric services. The company is investing in innovation around generative AI, cloud-native applications, and operational efficiencies.
categories.revenue_model: Nutanix operates a subscription-based revenue model, selling term-based software licenses, SaaS offerings, and associated support and entitlements, typically with durations of one to five years. Revenue is generated primarily through indirect sales channels (distributors, resellers, OEMs), with a mix of upfront and ratable revenue recognition depending on the product type. Professional services and occasional hardware sales contribute a small portion of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nutanix competes in the highly competitive IT infrastructure market against software providers like VMware by Broadcom, public cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Oracle Cloud), and traditional IT vendors (Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Pure Storage, NetApp, Huawei). The company is recognized as a leader in HCI and is expanding into adjacent markets such as Kubernetes management, cloud management, and AI infrastructure, positioning itself as an open, flexible alternative to legacy and public cloud solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended July 31, 2024, Nutanix reported total revenue of approximately $2.2 billion, with a year-over-year growth rate of 17.8% in 2023 and continued growth in 2024. The company has over 7,150 employees and a global customer base. While Nutanix has a history of GAAP net losses, it has achieved non-GAAP profitability in recent years and is focused on sustaining profitable growth and improving operating cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nutanix differentiates itself by offering a unified, open hybrid multicloud platform that simplifies IT operations, provides freedom of infrastructure choice, and supports a wide range of workloads, including AI and cloud-native applications. Its platform emphasizes ease of use, scalability, security, and interoperability with third-party hardware and public clouds, enabling customers to run applications and manage data anywhere without vendor lock-in. The company highlights customer success, operational simplicity, and innovation as key elements of its value proposition.
